content.text: {"id": "mm5833a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Cumulative incidence of ILI consultation during this period was 1,518 per 100,000 patient population."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "increased from 14% during the week of June 8--14 to 80% during the week of June 29--July 5"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The ILI consultation rate peaked at 287 consultations per 100,000 patient population in the week ending July 19"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "increased from 14% during the week of June 8--14 to 80% during the week of June 29--July 5"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Cumulative incidence of ILI consultation during this period was 1,518 per 100,000 patient population."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "approximately three times the peak rate of 95 consultations recorded in 2008"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Weekly national ILI consultation rates for the study period were compared with the same period in 2008 and 2007."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "title", "q": "Surveillance for the 2009 Pandemic Influenza A (H1N1) Virus and Seasonal Influenza Viruses"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Weekly national ILI consultation rates for the study period were compared with the same period in 2008 and 2007."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "National ILI consultation rates are calculated weekly using the sum of the GP patient populations as the denominator."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the denominator for age group--specific ILI consultation rates is based on New Zealand census data"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
